item.title: SonicWall SMA1000 WorkPlace SSRF → Internal Erlang RPC Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-15409)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — network · CVE-2026-15409 (SNWLID-2026-0008). Status: Weaponized — unauthenticated, non-root remote code execution confirmed against a real appliance build. Affects: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliance — WorkPlace interface (websocket proxy service). Tags: sonicwall, sma1000, workplace, ssrf, erlang, rpc, cwe-918, unauthenticated, remote, kev, actively-exploited.
